name: fleet-provider-config-propagation
title: Shipped provider-config fixes never reach fleet consumers
description: manifest.json installs 776 files, of which exactly two use install: if-not-exists -- .gito/config.toml and .prism/rules.json. For those, install.py --force reports preserved and writes nothing, so a correction to a broken shipped default has no delivery path. Release 0.64.21 narrowed the Gito .trellis exclusion that made sd-review dead-end on an all-excluded diff, but six of seven fleet repositories still carry the old blanket entry and install.py cannot update them. All six are byte-identical to the pre-0.64.21 template, so nothing local is being protected today. Give these configs an upgrade path that reaches an unmodified consumer, leaves a customized one alone, and reports the ones it leaves behind.
creator: sdelmas
